mapper.select: select cast(o.id as varchar) as orderId, o.order_no as orderNo, cast(o.listing_id as varchar) as listingId, l.title as listingTitle, o.source_type as sourceType, o.status as orderStatus, o.reservation_status as reservationStatus, case when o.status = 'SECOND_CHANCE' then o.payment_deadline else o.reservation_expires_at end as deadline, greatest(0, extract(epoch from statement_timestamp() - case when o.status = 'SECOND_CHANCE' then o.payment_deadline else o.reservation_expires_at end))::bigint as overdueSeconds from order_record o join listing l on l.id = o.listing_id where o.is_deleted = false and l.is_deleted = false and ( (o.source_type = 'SECKILL' and o.status = 'PENDING_PAYMENT' and o.reservation_status = 'RESERVED' and o.reservation_expires_at <= statement_timestamp()) or (o.status = 'SECOND_CHANCE' and o.payment_deadline <= statement_timestamp()) ) order by deadline, o.id limit #{limit}

select coalesce(( select to_char(sum(o.amount), 'FM999999999999999990.00') from order_record o where o.status = 'COMPLETED' and o.is_deleted = false ), '0.00') as completedGmv, coalesce(( select to_char(sum(w.available_balance), 'FM999999999999999990.00') from wallet_account w where w.account_code = 'PLATFORM_ESCROW' and w.is_deleted = false ), '0.00') as escrowBalance, (select count(*) from order_record where is_deleted = false) as totalOrders, (select count(*) from order_record where status in ('PENDING_PAYMENT', 'SECOND_CHANCE') and is_deleted = false) as pendingPaymentOrders, (select count(*) from order_record where status = 'DISPUTED' and is_deleted = false) as disputedOrders, (select count(*) from sale_channel where channel = 'AUCTION' and status = 'ACTIVE' and is_deleted = false) as activeAuctions, (select count(*) from sale_channel where channel = 'SECKILL' and status = 'ACTIVE' and is_deleted = false) as activeSeckills, (select count(*) from sale_channel where channel = 'SHOP' and status = 'ACTIVE' and is_deleted = false) as activeShops, (select count(*) from sale_channel where channel = 'AUCTION' and status = 'UNSOLD' and is_deleted = false) as unsoldAuctions, coalesce(round(100.0 * ( select count(*) from sale_channel auction_channel where auction_channel.channel = 'AUCTION' and auction_channel.status = 'UNSOLD' and auction_channel.is_deleted = false and exists ( select 1 from sale_channel next_channel where next_channel.listing_id = auction_channel.listing_id and next_channel.id > auction_channel.id and next_channel.channel in ('SECKILL', 'SHOP') and next_channel.is_deleted = false) ) / nullif(( select count(*) from sale_channel ended_channel where ended_channel.channel = 'AUCTION' and ended_channel.status in ('SOLD', 'UNSOLD') and ended_channel.is_deleted = false ), 0), 2), 0)::text as downgradeRate

select channels.channel, count(sc.id) filter (where sc.status = 'ACTIVE') as activeCount, count(sc.id) filter (where sc.status = 'SOLD') as soldCount, count(sc.id) filter (where sc.status = 'UNSOLD') as unsoldCount, count(sc.id) filter (where sc.status = 'SCHEDULED') as scheduledCount from (values ('AUCTION'), ('SECKILL'), ('SHOP')) as channels(channel) left join sale_channel sc on sc.channel = channels.channel and sc.is_deleted = false group by channels.channel order by case channels.channel when 'AUCTION' then 1 when 'SECKILL' then 2 else 3 end

with days as ( select generate_series( current_date - ((#{days} - 1) * interval '1 day'), current_date, interval '1 day')::date as day ) select days.day, count(o.id) as completedOrders, coalesce(to_char(sum(o.amount), 'FM999999999999999990.00'), '0.00') as completedAmount from days left join order_record o on o.status = 'COMPLETED' and o.is_deleted = false and o.gmt_modified::date = days.day group by days.day order by days.day

select cast(w.id as varchar) as accountId, w.account_code as accountCode, w.owner_type as ownerType, cast(w.owner_id as varchar) as ownerId, to_char(w.available_balance, 'FM999999999999999990.00') as availableBalance, to_char(w.frozen_balance, 'FM999999999999999990.00') as frozenBalance, to_char(coalesce(last_transaction.available_after, w.available_balance), 'FM999999999999999990.00') as ledgerAvailableBalance, to_char(coalesce(last_transaction.frozen_after, w.frozen_balance), 'FM999999999999999990.00') as ledgerFrozenBalance, to_char((w.available_balance - coalesce(last_transaction.available_after, w.available_balance)) + (w.frozen_balance - coalesce(last_transaction.frozen_after, w.frozen_balance)), 'FM999999999999999990.00') as difference, (w.available_balance = coalesce(last_transaction.available_after, w.available_balance) and w.frozen_balance = coalesce(last_transaction.frozen_after, w.frozen_balance)) as consistent from wallet_account w left join lateral ( select wt.available_after, wt.frozen_after from wallet_transaction wt where wt.account_id = w.id order by wt.id desc limit 1 ) last_transaction on true where w.is_deleted = false order by consistent asc, w.id desc limit #{limit}

select count(*) as totalCalls, count(*) filter (where status = 'SUCCEEDED') as succeededCalls, count(*) filter (where status = 'FAILED') as failedCalls, coalesce(sum(prompt_tokens), 0) as promptTokens, coalesce(sum(completion_tokens), 0) as completionTokens, round(avg(latency_ms))::bigint as averageLatencyMs from ai_task where is_deleted = false and gmt_create >= statement_timestamp() - interval '30 days'

select coalesce(model_name, 'UNKNOWN') as modelName, count(*) as calls, coalesce(sum(prompt_tokens), 0) as promptTokens, coalesce(sum(completion_tokens), 0) as completionTokens, round(avg(latency_ms))::bigint as averageLatencyMs, cast(null as varchar) as estimatedCost from ai_task where is_deleted = false and gmt_create >= statement_timestamp() - interval '30 days' group by model_name order by count(*) desc, model_name
